Welcome to my website! I'm a senior at Carnegie Mellon University, pursuing a degree in Statistics and Machine Learning. My academic and research interests center on causality—causal inference, causal discovery, and their integration with machine learning—to address critical healthcare challenges, particularly chronic diseases like Alzheimer’s. I’m passionate about leveraging data to uncover insights that can lead to better prevention and treatment strategies.
